title: Elite: Law Beneath the River Mirror
description: Elite remix of Law Beneath the River Mirror: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat. Appearance rule: Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper.
lore: This mission treats Solar Dominion of Khepra as the origin behind Egyptian solar myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale geometry, electrum, royal linen-light, faience turquoise, lapis, obsidian, Nile-black silt glass, Red Land jasper instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes

objectives.primary: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Solar Law: Momentum grows when the lone Titan holds marked light lanes without retreating.
Mirror Orders: enemies copy the last objective interaction unless interrupted.
Anchor Corruption: structures worsen hazards every two turns.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titan.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Drive your active Titan to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 9 codex shard
